headline: A construction company needed contracts and project administration strong enough for subcontractors and clients.
challenge: Construction projects depend on subcontractors, suppliers, permits and payment terms. Every weak agreement is a risk to the schedule and the margin.
delivered: Corporate compliance, tax compliance and applicable permits and registrations
Construction and subcontractor agreements, and procurement documentation
Contractual risk management and business development support
impact: A construction company with documented agreements, organised project administration and better coordination and commercial efficiency across its projects.
